entries.en: to overcome, to defeat; to subdue, to bring under control.
to overcome; to exceed, to surpass.
to surpass, to prevail over; to exceed.
to win a fight, to defeat (in combat); to fight.

entries.zh: 平服、胜过〔第二字污损（宜/亘？），释义存疑〕。
entries.en: to subdue, to overcome [second character smudged (yi/gen?); gloss uncertain].
entries.notes: 第二字声调 T99 污损且汉字[疑：宜/亘]、音写[疑：ŋy/gy]，仅据首字“平”与西语 vencer 定为“胜过/平服”义。

entries.en: to surpass, to outdo (in a contest).

entries.zh: 克伐；攻克、征伐（征服一国）。
entries.en: to conquer and vanquish; to subjugate, to conquer a kingdom.

entries.zh: 阵势（战阵形势）；谓战胜敌军〔第二字污损，释义存疑〕。
entries.en: battle array, disposition of forces; to defeat the enemy army [second character smudged; gloss uncertain].
entries.notes: 第二字声调 T99 污损（音写[疑：ŋy/gy]），汉字“陣勢”与西语短语 vencer a el exercito contrario 的对译关系存疑。

entries.zh: 赢阵；胜过敌阵、战胜敌军。
entries.en: to win the battle, to defeat the enemy array.
to win the battle, to gain the victory.

entries.zh: 战胜了；已打胜仗（完成貌）。
entries.en: to have won the battle; battle won (perfective).

entries.zh: 阵〔残〕赢：每阵必赢、屡战屡胜〔中字残损，释义存疑〕。
entries.en: to win every bout, always victorious [middle character damaged; gloss uncertain].
entries.notes: 汉字中字[残]、声调 T99，据音写 tĩ tĩ yã 拟为“陣陣贏”，对应 vencer siempre（每每获胜）。
西语头词涂改存疑（[疑：quadio/vencido]），释义依汉字“輸”与音写 su 而定。

entries.en: to lose (a fight), to be beaten.

entries.zh: 战输；战败（西语注：战中失利，通常如此用）。
entries.en: to lose a battle, to be defeated in war; commonly so used.
defeated in war; to be beaten in battle.

entries.zh: 阵〔残〕输：每阵必输、屡战屡败〔中字残损，释义存疑〕。
entries.en: to lose every bout, always defeated [middle character damaged; gloss uncertain].
entries.notes: 汉字中字[残]，据音写 tĩ tĩ su 拟为“陣陣輸”，对应 vencido siempre（每每战败）。

entries.en: to be no match in battle, to lose ('andar de vencida': to be on the losing side).
entries.notes: 仅第三音节声调 T99 污损，字面“戰不過”清晰，据西语 vencido/andar de vencida 定为“打不过、落败”。
vendaval 在 17 世纪西语海事用语中指西南风/风暴风，与汉字“西南”及音写 sai-lâm 相合；头词波浪号为缩略号。
